mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost of AI SEO services for a dental practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AI SEO services for a dental practice varies widely depending on the scope of services, the competitiveness of the local market, and the provider's expertise. Packages can range from a few hundred to several thousand dollars per month. Factors influencing cost include the depth of keyword research, content creation needs, technical SEO optimizations, and ongoing reporting and analysis. A customized quote is usually provided after an initial assessment of the practice's current online presence and goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost of AI SEO for dental practices varies from hundreds to thousands of dollars monthly, depending on service scope, market competitiveness, and provider expertise.
